items.text: Christian Watson questionable to return with chest injury mid-TNF; looked concerning for collarbone area.
items.why: Injured on catch; headed for further testing.
items.implication: In-game absence opens snaps for other Packers WRs (Golden active).
items.opportunity: Short-term WR2/3 upside for backups if out longer.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown listed as non-participant Thursday after limited Wednesday due to ankle and knee injuries. Status for Sunday up in the air.
items.why: Knee flare-up added to existing ankle issue; first missed practice since IR return.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk vs MIA; monitor Friday report closely.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury; status vs Chiefs to be determined based on practice. DNP Wednesday.
items.why: Aggravation on reverse in Week 7; availability practice-dependent.
items.implication: Iffy for tough KC matchup; Courtland Sutton beneficiary if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated targets for Sutton/others.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on HATE list. Production hasn't been there and Chiefs allowed just one TD to opposing WR all season (to JSN).
items.why: Poor recent prod + elite KC secondary vs WRs; plus chest injury uncertainty.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase full participant one day after DNP.
items.implication: Should be fine for Week 8; no major concern.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson full participant for second straight day.
items.why: Second consecutive full practice after missing three games with high-ankle sprain.
items.implication: Strongly expected to play vs BUF; unlocks Ravens pass game.
items.opportunity: Boosts Zay Flowers and other Ravens pass-catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers is my WR5 this week. Lamar Jackson expected back and I LOVE what that means for Flowers.
items.why: Lamar return unlocks track-meet Bills-Ravens; Flowers primary beneficiary.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start with QB back.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
items.implication: Potential return soon; monitor for role in crowded SEA backfield.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG in two games since Caleb Williams returned; leads TEs in utilization, top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: Massive target/utilization spike with Williams back.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) both full participants Thursday after Wednesday DNPs. Expected to play.
items.why: Wed DNPs (planned rest for St. Brown; shoulder scare for Gibbs); both full Thu and downplayed injuries.
items.implication: Both clear for Vikings matchup; maintain RB1/WR1 status.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite lost OC Klint Kubiak, limited supporting cast, and heavy coverage shading. Stadium knows the ball is going to him yet he delivers.
items.why: Elite efficiency and production vs depressed opportunity metrics post-coordinator change.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 upside; buy if discounted on lost OC narrative.
items.opportunity: High target share and YPRR despite scheme/personnel headwinds.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE/RB6 @ BUF. Favorable run matchup and history vs Bills.
items.why: Defenses that can't stop the run; Henry history vs BUF.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start in potential shootout.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/volume with Lamar back possible positive script.

items.text: Saquon Barkley HATE/RB20 @ WSH. Usage concerns amid team injuries.
